subject: Evaluation kickoff: Redwood trial plan & next steps (ACME)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & eval kickoff: Redwood trial plan & next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Appreciate the context on your ingestion pipeline and the primary success criteria (latency under 250ms P95 for 512-token queries, 95% relevance on the rerank set, and clear audit logs for QA). Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the evaluation going: 

- Recap: you’re evaluating Redwood to power assistant responses within ACME’s support portal and to run nightly reranking for knowledge retrieval.
- Key success criteria: latency P95 target (~250ms), relevance on the sample prompt set, and stable KV cache behavior across sessions.
- Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (60 min) — we’ll cover trial plan, roles, success metrics, data access, and an initial prompt set/evals.

I’ve attached a draft Eval Plan that lays out a 4-week trial with suggested prompts, rollout steps, and how we’ll measure results. Can you confirm availability for a 60-min kickoff? a few options:

- Thu Jun 10 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu Jun 10 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT
- Fri Jun 11 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT

We’ll include Vivek (solutions engineer) for the technical deep-dive and Olga from Customer Success on the onboarding/runbook. If procurement needs to join for SOW/PO discussions, please loop them in.

Attachments:
- ACME-Redwood-Eval-Plan.pdf (draft, includes agenda + success metrics)

If those times don’t work, suggest 2–3 alternatives and I’ll align calendars.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment: ACME-Redwood-Eval-Plan.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks Marissa — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. I looped procurement on the thread for visibility. A couple quick notes: 

- Preference: Fri Jun 11 2:00–3:00 PM PT works best for our team (we have customer calls on Thu).
- For the kickoff please include the example prompt set and a short note on how you measure "relevance" in the eval doc (precision@k / human ratings?).
- We’ll aim to have one engineer (infra lead) and one product owner on the call. Procurement may not need to attend the kickoff but will be on standby for contracting questions.

Can you send an invite for Jun 11 2pm PT with a calendar invite and any pre-reads? Also please flag if we need any access to test environments or example datasets ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Sarah
Senior Product Manager — Search & Assistant
Acme Corporation
